title: Find the K-Sum of an Array
summary: Given an integer array nums and a positive integer k, determine the k-th largest subsequence sum possible.
statement: Given an integer array nums and a positive integer k, determine the k-th largest subsequence sum possible. A subsequence is formed by deleting some or no elements from the original array while maintaining the order of the remaining elements. The empty subsequence has a sum of 0.
constraints: nums has up to 100000 signed integers; k is at most min(2000,2^n).
Every index may be included or excluded, and equal sums from different subsequences count separately.
Return the kth largest subsequence sum, including the empty subsequence sum zero.
reference_solution:
def kth_largest_subsequence_sum(nums,k):
    import heapq
    maximum=sum(value for value in nums if value>0);values=sorted(abs(value) for value in nums)
    if k==1:return maximum
    heap=[(values[0],0)];removed=0
    for _ in range(k-1):
        removed,index=heapq.heappop(heap)
        if index+1<len(values):
            heapq.heappush(heap,(removed+values[index+1],index+1))
            heapq.heappush(heap,(removed-values[index]+values[index+1],index+1))
    return maximum-removed

def kth_largest_subsequence_sum(nums,k):
    import heapq
    maximum=sum(value for value in nums if value>0);values=sorted(abs(value) for value in nums)
    if k==1:return maximum
    heap=[(values[0],0)];removed=0
    for _ in range(max(0,k-2)):
        removed,index=heapq.heappop(heap)
        if index+1<len(values):
            heapq.heappush(heap,(removed+values[index+1],index+1))
            heapq.heappush(heap,(removed-values[index]+values[index+1],index+1))
    return maximum-removed
hints: The largest subsequence sum includes every positive value and excludes every negative value.
Any other sum subtracts a subset of absolute values from that maximum.
Sort absolute values and use a min-heap to enumerate subset-removal costs in increasing order without generating all subsets.
The two heap transitions uniquely extend or replace the latest chosen absolute value, producing removal costs in order; subtracting the kth cost reverses them into descending subsequence sums.
